description: Append-only compact index of cumulative token-saving experiment records. Raw transcripts, usage logs, verifier output, quality reviews, and generated artifacts live under sources/evaluations/<study-id>/ or sources/evaluations/large-projects/<project-id>/runs/<evaluation-id>/.
append_policy: Add one immutable run record per executed baseline/treatment. Add paired_comparison records only after baseline and treatment run records exist. Supersede rather than edit historical results except for path typo correction with rationale.

target.dirty_state: seed-regression.patch applied; no other changes allowed at run start

agent.name: Hermes Agent
agent.model: bind at run start; must match paired baseline/treatment
agent.provider: bind at run start; must match paired baseline/treatment
agent.temperature: record at run start; use deterministic/default setting consistently

isolation_requirements: Run in a fresh agent session/profile where lean-ctx is the only token-saving/retrieval add-on.
Start with no reused index unless the treatment protocol explicitly measures warm-index behavior.
Record all lean-ctx calls in transcript and run record.
Audit transcript before accepting the run.

interpretation.notes: Real issue-derived multi-file planned run. Before execution, bind exact model/provider/version, execute setup, capture transcript/provider usage/verifier output/diff, run tool-isolation audit, then append compact record to data/evaluations.json.
